dialogues.speaker: Nekrasov
dialogues.text: He's our new safety officer. According to the rules, any prospective ice miner must pass the Safety Code exam before getting permission to enter the worksite.

dialogues.speaker: Nekrasov
dialogues.text: Oh, and don't say I didn't warn you. This new safety officer is stubborn as a mule. Reasoning won't work on him, and neither will pressure. For all I know, he might be cracked in the head, so whatever you do, don't provoke him.

dialogues.speaker: Nekrasov
dialogues.text: I really don't get it. Why would he give up a nice, comfortable life at the troupe just to come suffer in a backwater like this...?
